blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Robotic operation in previously unseen environments requires both semantic understanding and reliable metric information. While vision–language models (VLMs) provide strong semantic capabilities, their geometric estimates remain less reliable. In this paper, we propose a VLM-driven, modular perception framework for scene understanding using off-the-shelf approaches. Starting from a single RGB-D observation, the scene is segmented into object-level regions, annotated by a VLM, and grounded with depth information to construct a task-independent object-centric representation. Experiments on 151 tabletop scenes show that the proposed decomposition preserves strong semantic performance while substantially improving localization and depth estimation over direct VLM inference. The resulting representation is also integrated with a task-planning framework for robotic execution.
blocks.zh: 机器人在先前未见环境中的操作需要语义理解和可靠的度量信息. 虽然视觉-语言模型(VLMs)提供了很强的语义能力,但其几何估计仍然不太可靠. 在本文中,我们提出一个由VLM驱动的模块化感知框架,以便采用现成的方法进行场景理解. 从单一的RGB-D观测开始,场景被分割成对象级区域,由VLM注释,并以深度信息为基础构建一个任务独立的以对象为中心的代表. 151平面场景的实验表明,拟议的分解保留了强烈的语义性能,同时比直接的VLM推论大大改善了局部化和深度估计. 由此产生的代表性也与机器人执行的任务规划框架相结合。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Robotic manipulation in previously unseen environments is a fundamental open-issue, limiting the widespread of robotic solutions in unstructured environments. A robotic manipulator must recover semantic properties, metric geometry, and spatial relationships in a form that can subsequently support task reasoning and planning. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) [ 2 , 3 ] provide strong open-vocabulary semantic understanding without task-specific training, but are less suited to recovering the precise metric information required for physical interaction. Conversely, geometric perception methods [ 4 , 5 ] can recover the three-dimensional structure of a scene, but generally provide much weaker semantic understanding. As a consequence, most systems remain designed a for specific task and a single environment, and fail to address greater autonomy in unseen settings, which would require robots to perceive and reason about the environment.
blocks.zh: 在之前未见的环境中机器人操纵是一个根本性的开放性问题,限制了机器人解决方案在无结构环境中的广泛性. 机器人操纵器必须恢复语义属性,度量几何,空间关系,其形式可以支持任务推理和规划. 近期的视觉语言模型(VLMs)[2,3]在没有任务特定训练的情况下提供了强烈的开放式语义理解,但不太适合恢复物理交互所需的精确的度量信息. 反之,几何感知方法[4,5]可以恢复一个场景的三维结构,但一般能提供更弱的语义理解. 因此,大多数系统仍然是为具体任务和单一环境设计的,无法解决在隐形环境中更大的自主性问题,这将要求机器人了解和解释环境。

blocks.en: In this work, we investigate whether these complementary capabilities can be combined to obtain a task-independent description of an unknown scene from a single RGB-D observation, without scene-specific training or fine-tuning. We explicitly separate semantic interpretation (VLM-driven) from geometric estimation (fusing segmentation and depth information), using off-the-shelf models . In our framework (Fig. 2 ), foundation segmentation models such as SAM [ 6 ] first decompose the RGB observation into candidate scene entities. The complete image and the resulting object masks are then annotated by a general-purpose, multimodal foundation model [ 2 , 3 ] . Finally, the segmented regions are associated with the corresponding RGB-D measurements to recover metric object information. We empirically demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach compared to end-to-end VLM baselines (Sec. V-B – V-D ).
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们调查这些互补能力是否可以结合,从一次RGB-D观测中获得一个未知场景的任务独立描述,而无需进行场景特定训练或微调. 我们使用现成模型,将语义解释(VLM驱动)与几何估计(分解和深度信息)明确区分开来。 在我们的框架(图2)中,SAM[6]等基础分割模型首先将RGB观测分解为候选场景实体. 完整的图像和由此而来的物体口罩然后用通用的,多式的基础模型[2,3]作注释. 最后,分块区域与相应的RGB-D测量相关,以回收测量对象信息. 我们从经验上证明了这一方法与从端到端的VLM基线(Sec. V-B – V-D)相比的有效性.

blocks.en: The resulting object-centric representation combines semantic and geometric information in a form that can be queried independently of the task. It can therefore serve as an interface to symbolic and language-based planning frameworks such as [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] , linking open-vocabulary perception with downstream robotic planning. We demonstrate the effectiveness of this integration in a real robot sorting task (Sec. V-E ), shown in Fig. 1 .
blocks.zh: 由此产生的以物体为中心的表示方式将语义信息和几何信息结合起来,其形式可以独立于任务进行询问. 因此,它可以作为象征性的和基于语言的规划框架的接口,如[7,8,9],将开放-vobulary感知与下游机器人规划联系起来. 我们在真正的机器人排序任务(Sec.V-E)中展示了这种集成的有效性,如图1所示。

blocks.en: II-A Learning and Foundation Models for Robotic Manipulation
blocks.zh: II-A 机器人操纵的学习和基础模型

blocks.en: Learning-based robotic manipulation has increasingly exploited heterogeneous multimodal supervision. M π \pi X [ 10 ] learns manipulation policies from demonstrations expressed through speech, images, text, and video through modality-specific encoders and a unified training framework. SAILOR [ 11 ] similarly leverages heterogeneous offline data for imitation learning, while BridgeData [ 12 ] provides large-scale manipulation trajectories across diverse environments. These approaches improve behavioral generalization but primarily learn observation-to-action mappings from previously collected robot data rather than constructing an explicit, reusable representation of an unseen scene.
blocks.zh: 基于学习的机器人操纵越来越多地利用了多种多样的多式联运监督。 M \\ pi X [10] 通过特定模式的编码器和统一的训练框架,从通过语音,图像,文本和视频表达的演示中学习操纵政策. SAILOR [11] 类似地利用各种离线数据进行仿真学习,而BridgeData [12] 提供了跨越不同环境的大规模操纵轨迹. 这些方法改进了行为概括,但主要是从先前收集的机器人数据中学习观察到行动绘图,而不是构建一个清晰的,可重复使用的看不见场景的表述.

blocks.en: Language-conditioned methods, instead, combine semantic reasoning with geometric information. CLIPort [ 13 ] integrates language-conditioned semantic features with RGB-D observations to learn language-conditioned pick-and-place policies. VoxPoser [ 14 ] and ReKep [ 15 ] ground high-level reasoning into 3D spatial and temporal manipulation. These methods show the importance of combining high-level semantic reasoning with geometric information. However, their representations are task-conditioned, focusing on the entities and relations required for a specific instruction. In contrast, our work focuses on constructing a task-independent representation.
blocks.zh: 相反,语言条件化的方法将语义推理与几何信息结合起来. CLIPort [13] 将语言条件的语义特征与RGB-D的观察结合起来,学习语言条件的选位政策. VoxPoser [14] 和 ReKep [15] 地面高层次推理进入3D空间和时间操纵. 这些方法表明了将高级语义推理与几何信息相结合的重要性. 然而,他们的陈述是以任务为条件的,侧重于具体指示所需的实体和关系。 相反,我们的工作重点是建立一个独立的任务代表机构。

blocks.en: II-B Geometric and Open-Vocabulary Scene Understanding
blocks.zh: II-B 几何和开放式词汇理解

blocks.en: A complementary line of research focuses on geometry reconstruction. Modern monocular models such as Depth Anything [ 4 ] can estimate dense depth maps from a single RGB image, while models such as VGGT [ 5 ] exploit learned geometric priors for 3D reconstruction and camera estimation. Nevertheless, single-view reconstruction remains intrinsically ambiguous, and predicted depth is not necessarily metric. Multi-view observations can alleviate these limitations, but are incompatible with settings with single observations. RGB-D sensing, instead, provides direct metric measurements, which are particularly useful in manipulation scenarios requiring accurate distances and object dimensions.
blocks.zh: 一项补充研究侧重于几何重建。 现代单极模型如深度Anything[4]可以从一个单一的RGB图像中估算密度深度地图,而VGGT[5]等模型则利用所学几何前兆进行3D重建与相机估计. 然而,单一观点的重建仍然内在模糊不清,预测的深度不一定是衡量的。 多视图观测可以缓解这些局限性,但与单个观测的设置不兼容. 相反,RGB-D感知提供了直接的测量尺度,在需要精确距离和物体维度的操纵情景中特别有用.

blocks.en: Semantic understanding can also be performed directly in 3D. Methods such as RandLA-Net [ 16 ] and the Point Transformer family [ 17 , 18 ] provide powerful tools for point-cloud semantic segmentation. However, while they achieve high segmentation performance for the target data distribution, their vocabulary and generalization remain limited. Our approach targets open-vocabulary understanding without scene-specific training.
blocks.zh: 语义理解也可以直接在3D中进行. RandLA-Net [16]和Point Transformer家族[17,18]等方法为点-云语分区提供了强大的工具. 然而,虽然它们在目标数据分布上实现了高分化性能,但其词汇和概括性仍然有限. 我们的目标是在没有具体现场培训的情况下进行开放式的省会理解。

blocks.en: Foundation segmentation and vision-language models offer an alternative. SAM and SAM 2 enable class-agnostic image segmentation, separating the problem of locating scene entities from assigning them predefined semantic classes [ 19 , 20 ] . SAM 3 extends this paradigm by detecting, segmenting, and tracking all instances matching a text or a visual concept prompt [ 6 ] . Region-conditioned multimodal models such as Describe Anything [ 3 ] can generate detailed descriptions conditioned on selected image regions, while other approaches combine localized descriptions with spatial or geometric structure [ 21 , 22 ] . Our work follows this direction but explicitly couples region-level semantics with metric RGB-D measurements for physical interaction. This decomposition is particularly attractive for robotics because mature RGB foundation models can be retained for semantic reasoning, while depth is processed independently to recover metric geometry.
blocks.zh: 基础划分和愿景语言模式提供了一个替代办法。 SAM和SAM 2可以实现类不可知图像分割,将定位场景实体的问题与指定它们预先定义的语义类区分开来[19,20]. SAM 3通过检测,分割,跟踪所有匹配文本或视觉概念的事件来扩展这个范式[6]. 以区域为条件的多式联运模型,例如描述任何[3],可以生成以特定图像区域为条件的详细描述,而其他方法则将局部描述与空间或几何结构结合[21,22]. 我们的工作遵循这个方向,但明确地将区域层面的语义与物理相互作用的RGB-D度量结合。 这种分解对机器人特别有吸引力,因为成熟的RGB基础模型可以保留用于语义推理,而深度则独立处理以恢复度量几何.

blocks.en: II-C Open-Vocabulary 3D Representations
blocks.zh: II-C 开放式词汇3D 代表

blocks.en: Recent works combine 2D foundation model semantics with explicit 3D representations. ConceptFusion [ 23 ] fuses open-set visual features with geometric reconstruction to construct queryable multimodal 3D maps. ConceptGraphs [ 24 ] builds object-centric scene graphs with open-vocabulary features and spatial relations. OpenMask3D [ 25 ] and Open3DIS [ 26 ] similarly combine 3D geometry with masks or features obtained from 2D foundation models to perform open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation.
blocks.zh: 近期的作品结合了2D基础模型语义和明确的3D表达. ConceptFusion [23] 将带有几何重建的开立面特征引信,以构建可查询的多式3D地图. ConceptGraphs [24] 构建以物体为中心的场景图,具有开放-vobulary特征和空间关系. OpenMask3D [25] 和 Open3DIS [26] 类似地将3D几何学与从2D基础模型中获得的口罩或特征结合起来,以进行开放-vobulary 3D实例分割.

blocks.en: These approaches demonstrate the effectiveness of persistent 3D mapping, retrieval, and open-vocabulary segmentation of large scenes. In contrast, we focus on the complementary problem of extracting from a single RGB-D observation a compact object-centric representation for downstream robotic reasoning, associating each entity with natural-language semantics and directly measured metric information.
blocks.zh: 这些方法表明了持续3D绘图、检索和大面积场景的开放式分解的有效性。 相比之下,我们侧重于从单一RGB-D观测中提取下游机器人推理的紧凑对象中心代表,将每个实体与自然语言语义和直接测量的计量信息联系起来这一互补问题。

blocks.en: II-D Structured Representations for Task Planning
blocks.zh: 任务规划结构化代表机构

blocks.en: Explicit scene structure becomes particularly important in several robotic tasks, including assembly, where success depends not only on recognizing components but also on recovering attributes, poses, dimensions, and spatial relationships. Neural Assembler [ 27 ] estimates component masks, poses, relationships, and assembly sequences from multi-view observations, WorkBenchMark [ 28 ] studies LEGO Duplo assembly through structured reasoning over object properties and relative poses. These works highlight the value of object-centric representations, but focus on task-specific assembly settings.
blocks.zh: 在包括组装在内的若干机器人任务中,清晰的场景结构变得特别重要,这些任务的成功不仅取决于识别组件,而且还取决于恢复属性、姿势、维度和空间关系。 神经元Assembler[27]从多视图观测中估算组件遮罩,姿势,关系和组装序列,Work BenchMark[28]通过结构化推理来研究LEGO Duplo组装相对于物体属性和相对姿势. 这些作品凸显了以对象为中心的表现值,但专注于特定任务组装设置.

blocks.en: In contrast, our work separates scene perception from task reasoning. From a single RGB-D observation, we construct a generic object-centric representation without object-specific perception models or scene-specific fine-tuning. The resulting knowledge base can subsequently be interpreted according to the task at hand, and interfaced with higher-level reasoning and planning approaches [ 8 ] . This separation is intended to preserve the generality of modern foundation models while exposing the explicit metric structure required for robotic manipulation.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,我们的工作将场景感知与任务推理区分开来. 从单一的RGB-D观测中,我们构建了一个通用的以对象为中心的代表,没有特定对象的感知模型或特定场景的微调. 由此产生的知识库随后可以根据手头的任务加以解释,并与更高层次的推理和规划方法相衔接[8]. 这种分离是为了保持现代基础模型的通俗性,同时暴露机器人操纵所需的明确度量结构.

Each semantic description is therefore explicitly grounded to the
corresponding physical region of the workspace. The resulting representation
can be interpreted both as a semantically annotated geometric reconstruction
and as a compact object-centric knowledge base.
Indeed, given a natural-language instruction, a downstream reasoning module can query 𝒪 \mathcal{O} to identify relevant entities, reason over their semantic properties and relationships, and retrieve their metric information for
planning or manipulation. Since 𝒪 \mathcal{O} is constructed independently of
the task, the same scene representation can be reused across different
instructions.
Human instructions can therefore be interpreted with respect to the reconstructed scene, allowing the system to identify relevant entities and spatial relations and to derive the scene information required for downstream robotic tasks.
The framework is also modular with respect to the segmentation, annotation,
and depth-estimation backends, which can be replaced independently while
preserving the same object-level interface.

blocks.en: IV Dataset
blocks.zh: 四. 数据集

blocks.en: To evaluate the proposed framework, we collected an RGB-D dataset comprising 151 tabletop scene configurations using an Orbbec Femto Mega camera. For each scene, the dataset contains: 1) an RGB image with a resolution of 1920 × 1080 1920\times 1080 pixels and 2) a corresponding 640 × 576 640\times 576 16-bit depth image. Since the RGB and depth sensors have different formats, the raw depth observations are not directly pixel-aligned with the RGB images, but are registered as described in Sec. III-D . Examples of scenes in the dataset are shown in Fig. 3 .
blocks.zh: 为了评价拟议框架,我们利用Orbbec Femto Mega相机收集了由151台台式计算机场景配置组成的RGB-D数据集。 对于每个场景,数据集包含: 1) RGB图像,分辨率为1920×1080 1920\times 1080像素和2),对应的640×576 640\times 576 16位深度图像. 由于RGB和深度传感器有不同的格式,原始深度观测不直接与RGB图像像素对齐,而是按照Sec. III-D.中描述的注册. 图3显示了数据集中的场景实例。

blocks.en: The scenes were constructed by varying the number, identity, and spatial arrangement of the objects placed within the robot workspace. Overall, the dataset contains 26 distinct objects, including blocks with different shapes and colors, bottles, boxes, tools, measurement devices, a cup, a wallet, and ping-pong balls. Each scene contains between one and five task objects. The robot base and end-effector are additionally represented in the reference annotations when visible. This results in scenes with objects presenting substantially different appearance, size, shape, and semantic properties, while repeated occurrences of the same objects at different locations allow the consistency of the perception pipeline to be evaluated across different scene configurations.
blocks.zh: 场景是通过机器人工作空间内放置的物体的数量,身份和空间安排的不同来构建的. 总的来说,数据集包含26个不同的对象,包括形状和颜色不同的块,瓶子,盒子,工具,测量装置,一个杯子,一个钱包,以及乒乓球. 每个场景包含一个到五个任务对象. 机器人底部和末端效应器在可见时会在参考说明中附加表示. 这导致了各种场景,物体的外观,大小,形状,和语义属性都大不相同,而同一物体在不同地点的反复出现则使得感官管道的一致性可以在不同的场景配置中进行评价.

blocks.en:
For quantitative evaluation, each clean observation is associated with a second RGB image in which ArUco markers are introduced as pose and semantic references. A dedicated marker is associated with each object identity, while an additional marker defines the world reference frame. Given the calibrated camera parameters and the known marker size, the detected fiducials provide reference object identities and their geometric position with respect to the camera and world frames. Importantly, the marker-augmented images are used only to construct the reference annotations and are never provided as input to the proposed perception framework. All segmentation and semantic reasoning experiments operate exclusively on the corresponding clean RGB images.
Moreover, the dataset is used exclusively for evaluation: none of the segmentation, vision-language, or depth-estimation models are trained or fine-tuned on these images. This setup is consistent with the objective of evaluating the framework under a zero-shot, task-independent perception setting.
blocks.zh:
对于定量评价,每次清洁观测都与第二个RGB图像相关,其中ArUco标记被引入为姿势和语义参考. 一个专用标记与每个对象身份相关,而另一个标记则定义了世界参考框架. 考虑到校准的相机参数和已知的标记大小,检测到的微分提供了相机和世界帧的参考对象身份及其几何位置. 重要的是,标记增强的图像仅用于构建参考说明,从未作为拟议感知框架的投入。 所有分解和语义推理实验都完全在相应的清洁RGB图像上运行.
此外,数据集专门用于评价:没有对这些图像进行分区、视觉语言或深度估计模型的培训或微调。 这种设置符合在零镜头,任务独立的感知设定下评价框架的目标.

blocks.en: V Experimental Evaluation
blocks.zh: 五. 实验评价

blocks.en: TABLE I: The results obtained when using a VLM to do annotation and geometric grounding. The model was in charge of annotating the objects in the environment, producing the position in the image of the object and estimating the depth from the camera.
blocks.zh: 表格 页:1 使用VLM进行注释和几何定位时得到的结果. 该模型负责在环境中对物体进行注释,在物体的图像中产生位置,并从相机中估计深度.

blocks.en: The experiments clarify the central claim of the proposed framework: while VLMs provide strong semantic understanding of visual scenes, metric geometric information is more reliably obtained by specialized perception tools. We therefore compare direct VLM inference, in which both semantic annotations and object depth are inferred from the RGB image, against the proposed architecture, where the VLM is used for semantic reasoning while geometric information is obtained independently and associated with the corresponding segmented objects.
blocks.zh: 实验澄清了拟议框架的中心主张:虽然VLMs提供了对视觉场景的强烈语义理解,但是通过专门的感知工具更可靠地获取了度量几何信息. 因此,我们比较了直接的VLM推论,在这种推论中,语义说明和对象深度都从RGB图像中推导出来,与提议的架构相比,VLM用于语义推理,而几何信息则独立获取,并与相应的分形对象相关.

blocks.en: V-A Evaluation Protocol and Metrics
blocks.zh: V-A 评价议定书和计量

blocks.en: For semantic evaluation, predictions are associated with the reference annotations through their semantic tags. For each scene, predicted and ground-truth tag names are normalized and semantic recall is computed as the fraction of ground-truth tags appearing among the predictions. The recall reported in the following tables is the average across all dataset scenes.
blocks.zh: 对于语义评价,预测通过它们的语义标记与参考说明相关. 对每个场景,预测和地面真实标记名称都正常化,语义记忆被计算为预测中地面真实标记的一小部分。 下表报告的召回是所有数据集场景的平均值。

blocks.en: For geometric evaluation, a predicted object is associated with the ArUco reference carrying the same normalized semantic tag. Image-space localization error is computed as the Euclidean distance between the center of the predicted bounding box and the reference position obtained from the corresponding ArUco marker, and is reported through median error and root mean squared error (RMSE) in pixels. Depth is evaluated against the metric distance obtained from the calibrated ArUco reference. We report the median absolute error and RMSE in millimeters, considering only matched objects for which a valid depth estimate is available.
blocks.zh: 就几何评价而言,一个预测对象与ArUco参考物相关,该参考物带有相同的常态语义标记. 图像-空间本地化错误作为预测边框中心与从相应的ArUco标记获得的参考位置之间的欧几里得距离计算,并通过像素中的中位错误和根平均方差(RMSE)进行报告. 深度根据校准的ArUco参考文献获得的度量距离进行评估。 我们报告以毫米计的中位绝对误差和RMSE,只考虑有有效深度估计的匹配对象。

blocks.en: V-B VLM-Only Baseline
blocks.zh: 仅限基线

blocks.en: This experiment aims at showing that VLMs alone are not sufficient for accurate 3D scene interpretation. To this end, we consider the zero-shot use of the VLM as the baseline for this work. For this first experiment, we use a pool of available VLMs, considering both proprietary and open-source models. As proprietary models, we considered two alternatives from Anthropic and OpenAI. From Anthropic, we used Claude Sonnet 4.6, setting only the maximum number of tokens used to 8192 8192 , sufficiently above the expected structured output length to avoid truncation. From OpenAI, we tested three models, namely GPT 5.4, GPT 5.4-Mini and GPT 5.4-Nano, to show the differences that models of the same family can have. For these models, we set the max token usage to 16384 16384 and the seed to 42 42 . Both Sonnet and the GPT models were queried through the Azure SDK. We also included two models from Qwen that are open-source and that can be run locally. The two models that were considered are Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B , later referred to as Qwen 3-VL and Qwen 3.6, respectively. These models were run on a server equipped with one Nvidia A100 with 80GB of VRAM. As for the parameters, for both models, we set the maximum number of generated tokens to 8192 8192 , the temperature to 0 0 , top_p (nucleus sampling) to 1.0 1.0 , and the random seed to 42 42 . The combination of zero temperature and top_p = 1.0 \texttt{top\_p}=1.0 results in deterministic greedy decoding.
blocks.zh: 这一实验旨在表明单是VLM不足以准确的3D场景解释. 为此,我们认为无镜头使用甚高频作为这项工作的基准。 对于这个第一次实验,我们使用一组可用的VLM,既考虑专有模型,也考虑开源模型. 作为专有模型,我们考虑了Anthropic和OpenAI的两个替代品. 从Anthropic开始,我们使用Claude Sonnet 4.6,只设定了使用的代号的最大数量为8192 8192,足够高于预期的结构输出长度,以避免截断. 我们从OpenAI测试了三种模型,即GPT 5.4,GPT 5.4-Mini和GPT 5.4-Nano,以显示同一家族的模型可能存在的差异. 对于这些型号,我们设定最大标志使用量为16384 16384,种子为42 42. 通过Azure SDK对Sonnet和GPT模型都进行了询问. 我们还包括了来自Quen的两个开源型号,可以在当地运行. 考虑的两个型号分别是:Qune3-VL-4B-指示11 1 https://huggingface.co/Quen/Quen3-VL-4B-Instruct和Qune3.6-35B-A3B 2 2 https://huggingface.co/Quen3.6-35B-A3B,后来分别称为Quen 3-VL和Quen 3.6. 这些型号运行在一个配备一台装有80GB的VRAM的Nvidia A100的服务器上. 至于参数,对于两种模型,我们设定生成的代币的最大数量为8192 8192 ,温度为 0 0,顶端_p(核取样)为1.0 1.0,随机种子为42 42 . 0温和顶端=1.0\textt{top\_p}=1.0的结合,导致定型贪婪解码.

blocks.en: For each model, the prompt provided a single RGB image together with the set of admissible semantic labels and asking the model, in an open-vocabulary setting, to jointly predict the object classes, their image-space bounding boxes, and their metric distance from the camera. The models were not fine-tuned for this particular task, nor were they provided with in-context demonstrations. The results in Table I show that the models are reliable at identifying objects and providing the correct tags for them, with GPT 5.4 reaching a 95.9 95.9 % recall. GPT 5.4 and 5.4-mini, as well as Sonnet 4.6, are also good at estimating the 2D position of the objects in the scene, with median errors comparable to the ones of the whole pipeline shown in Table II . However, the models fall short when having to estimate the depth of the objects in the scene. This implies an inaccurate estimation of the 3D position, which is not compatible with typical robot manipulation tasks.
blocks.zh: 对于每个模型,提示提供了单一的RGB图像以及一组可受理的语义标签,并要求模型在一个开放的-vocabulary设置中共同预测对象类别,它们的图像-空格框,以及它们与相机的度量距离. 这些模型没有针对这一具体任务进行微调,也没有提供内文演示。 表一的结果显示,这些模型在识别物体和为物体提供正确标记方面是可靠的,GPT 5.4的回收率达到95.9 95.9%。 GPT 5.4和5.4-mini,以及Sonnet 4.6,也擅长估计现场物体的2D位置,中位误差可与表二所示整个输油管的误差相当. 然而,当需要估计场景中物体的深度时,模型还不足. 这意味着对3D位置的估计不准确,这与典型的机器人操纵任务不兼容.

blocks.en: TABLE II: Experiments run for the pipeline. For each combination of segmentation model, annotation model and depth tool, we report semantic recall, the median and root mean squared error (RMSE) of the image-space position in pixels, and the median absolute error and RMSE of the depth estimate in millimeters.
blocks.zh: 表格 二:为输油管进行实验. 对于分区模型,注释模型和深度工具的每一个组合,我们报告语义召回,像素中图像-空间位置的中位和根平均平方误差(RMSE),以及深度估计的中位绝对误差和RMSE(毫米).

blocks.en: V-C Pipeline experiments
blocks.zh: V-C管道实验

blocks.en: For the pipeline, we chose different models both for the segmentation and the annotation. For the segmentation, we considered SAM3 [ 6 ] , SAM2 [ 20 ] (with checkpoint sam2-l ), SAM1 [ 19 ] (with checkpoint sam1-h ), and FastSAM [ 29 ] . For the annotation, we considered the same models tested in Sec. V-B . For SAM3, we report the results in combination with all the VLM models, while for SAM1, SAM2, and FastSAM, we report only the best results (obtained with GPT 5.4).
blocks.zh: 对于输油管,我们选择了不同的型号 无论是分块还是注释。 关于分区问题,我们认为SAM3 [6],SAM2 [20] (带有检查站sam2-l),SAM1 [19] (带有检查站sam1-h),以及FastSAM [29]. 对于注解,我们考虑了同样的模型 在Sec. V -B测试。 就SAM3而言,我们报告的结果与所有VLM模型相结合,而就SAM1、SAM2和FastSAM而言,我们只报告最佳结果(与GPT 5.4)。

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 2 , we used a VLM to precondition the SAM3 model. In particular, we used the same VLM employed for the subsequent semantic annotation stage, so as not to introduce an additional model-dependent variable in the comparison. The preconditioning model was asked to identify all visible non-background objects in the scene and represent them as short noun phrases, using visual attributes such as color, size, and overall shape to distinguish different object types. The prompt additionally included a small set of in-context examples illustrating suitable and unsuitable concept formulations, and the resulting phrases were then provided to SAM3 as segmentation prompts.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,我们使用VLM作为SAM3模型的前提条件. 特别是,我们使用了用于随后语义注释阶段的相同的VLM,以避免在比较中引入额外的模型依赖变量. 先决条件模型被要求识别场景中所有可见的非背景对象,并把它们作为短名词短语来表示,使用颜色,大小,整体形状等视觉属性来区分不同的对象类型. 此外,还提供了一小组说明适当和不合适概念表述的文字实例,然后将由此产生的短语作为分块提示提供给SAM3。

blocks.en: For SAM1, SAM2, and FastSAM, we adopted a different approach: we relied on their automatic and class-agnostic segmentation capabilities, without semantic preconditioning. The models were first used to generate candidate masks over the entire image, first removing background regions and redundant or too small masks. The remaining object masks were then passed independently to the VLM for semantic annotation.
blocks.zh: 对于SAM1,SAM2和FastSAM,我们采取了另一种方法:我们依靠他们的自动和阶级不可知的分解能力,没有语义上的前提条件. 这些模型首先用于在整个图像上产生候选口罩,首先去除背景区域以及多余或太小的口罩. 剩下的物体口罩随后被独立传递到VLM进行语义注释.

blocks.en: The VLMs used for the semantic annotation, instead, were instructed to assign to each segmented object one of the predefined semantic tags, using both the full scene and the corresponding object crop as visual context, without providing task-specific examples or demonstrations.
blocks.zh: 相反,用于语义注释的VLM被指示给每个片段对象指定一个预先定义的语义标记,同时使用完整的场景和相应的对象裁剪作为视觉上下文,而不提供特定任务的例子或演示.

blocks.en: The following experiments were carried out exploiting the depth metadata from the RGB-D images. The error on the position is computed w.r.t the bounding box of the masks, and the depth is extracted as the median of the depth values of the pixels in the mask.
blocks.zh: 以下实验利用了RGB-D图像的深度元数据。 位置上的误差是按口罩的边框w.r.t计算的,深度被提取为口罩中像素深度值的中位数.

blocks.en: The results in Table II show that introducing specialized perception components substantially improves the geometric information associated with each object, while preserving a semantic recall comparable to the VLM-only baseline. For instance, SAM3 with GPT 5.4 achieves a recall of 94.1%, compared with 95.9% for the corresponding VLM-only baseline. The differences in depth estimation are particularly pronounced. Across the six VLM backends evaluated with SAM3, the average per-configuration median depth error decreases from 192.0 mm with direct VLM inference to 12.1 mm with the proposed pipeline, corresponding to an absolute reduction of 179.9 mm, or 93.7%.
blocks.zh: 表二的结果显示,引入专门的感知元件大大改进了与每个物体相关的几何信息,同时保留了与VLM唯一基准相仿的语义记忆. 例如,SAM3和GPT 5.4的召回率为94.1%,而对应的仅以VLM为基准的召回率为95.9%。 深度估计的差异特别明显。 在用SAM3评估的6个VLM后端中,每个配置的平均中位深度误差从192.0毫米直接VLM推算下降到12.1毫米,与拟议的管道相对应,绝对误差为179.9毫米,即93.7%。

blocks.en: Overall, experiments in Sec. V-B and V-C support the main hypothesis of this work: VLMs are effective semantic annotators, but they are less reliable when having to infer geometric quantities. Enhancing the scene by leveraging simple perception tools for localization and depth estimation yields a more accurate representation without sacrificing the semantic accuracy of VLMs.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,Sec. V-B和V-C中的实验支持了这项工作的主要假设: VLM是有效的语义注释器,但在需要推断几何量时,它们不太可靠. 通过利用简单的感知工具进行局部化和深度估计来增强场景,在不牺牲VLM的语义准确性的情况下,产生更准确的表示.

blocks.en: V-D Depth Techniques Ablation
blocks.zh: V-D 深度技术

blocks.en: For the results reported in Sec. V-C , we used measured depth data from the RGB-D pictures, and computed the depth as the median of the pixels in the mask. We also carried out experiments using a depth prediction model, namely Depth Anything V3 [ 4 ] (DA3). This is useful to investigate the possibility of deploying the proposed pipeline when only RGB images are available. Moreover, we also tested a naïve technique to compute the depth of the objects by taking the depth of the pixel at the center of the bounding box of the masks. This ablation evaluates whether exploiting the complete object region provides an advantage over a single representative image location.
blocks.zh: 对于在Sec.V-C中报告的结果,我们使用了从RGB-D图片中测得的深度数据,并计算出深度为面具中像素的中位数. 我们还利用深度预测模型进行了实验,即深度Anything V3 [4] (DA3). 这有助于调查在只有RGB图像的情况下部署拟议管道的可能性。 此外,我们还测试了一种天真技术,通过在口罩的边框中央取出像素的深度来计算物体的深度. 这种衰减评价了利用完整的物体区域是否比一个具有代表性的图像位置提供了优势。

blocks.en: TABLE III: Depth estimation ablation for RGB-D and Depth Anything 3 using mask-median and bounding-box-center depth extraction. Median absolute error and RMSE are reported in millimeters.
blocks.zh: 表三:使用口罩介质和边框中心深度提取法对RGB-D和深度Anything 3进行深度估计膨胀. 中位数绝对错误和RMSE以毫米表示.

blocks.en: Fig. 4: Above, three pictures of the real-world experiment showing the initial state (with overlays for the segmented objects), an intermediate configuration and the final state (from left to right). Below, the high-level task description passed to the task planner is shown.
blocks.zh: 图4:上方,三幅真实世界实验的图片,显示初始状态(带有分块对象的重叠),中间配置和最终状态(从左到右). 下面是转交任务规划员的高级别任务说明。

blocks.en:
The results of this study are shown in Table III . Focusing on the approach to compute the depth, it is clear that exploiting the complete segmentation mask provides a more reliable estimate than sampling a single pixel at the center of its bounding box. This trend is consistent across all segmentation and annotation combinations, both when using measured RGB-D data and when relying on DA3 predictions. Averaging the per-configuration median depth errors across all evaluated
configurations, the mask-median strategy reduces the median depth error from 15.8 mm to 13.2 mm with RGB-D data, and from 100.1 mm to 69.9 mm with DA3, corresponding to reductions of approximately 16.7% and 30.1%, respectively. The comparison also supports the use of the segmentation mask as the interface between the semantic and geometric components of the framework. Rather than relying on an arbitrary representative pixel, aggregating depth over the pixels belonging to the segmented object makes the estimate less sensitive to local prediction errors, missing depth measurements, and cases in which the center of the bounding box does not correspond to the visible surface of the target object.
blocks.zh:
这项研究的结果见表三。 专注于计算深度的方法,很明显,利用完整的分割面罩提供了比在其边框中心取样一个像素更可靠的估计. 在使用测量的RGB-D数据以及依赖DA3预测时,在所有分解和注释组合中,这一趋势是一致的. 对所有评价的每个配置的中位深度误差进行对比
配置,口罩介质策略用RGB-D数据将中位深度误差从15.8毫米降低到13.2毫米,用DA3将中位深度误差从100.1毫米降低到69.9毫米,分别约16.7%和30.1%. 比较还支持使用分割面罩作为框架的语义和几何构件的接口. 与其依赖任意的具有代表性的像素,在属于被分割对象的像素上聚集深度,使得估计对局部预测错误的敏感度降低,深度测量缺失,以及边框中心与目标对象的可见表面不符的情况.

blocks.en: Results also show that measured RGB-D information provides the most accurate geometric estimates. This is an expected result, since measured information is generally more accurate than an estimate. Nevertheless, the results obtained with DA3 remain substantially more accurate than the depth estimates produced directly by the VLMs (Table I ). Across the same six VLM backends evaluated with SAM3, the average per-configuration median depth error decreases from 192.0 mm with direct VLM inference to 71.3 mm with DA3 and mask-median aggregation, corresponding to a reduction of 120.7 mm, or 62.8%. Similarly, the average RMSE decreases from 272.0 mm to 131.5 mm, a reduction of 140.6 mm, or 51.7%. This is particularly relevant when an RGB-D sensor is not available, as it shows that the proposed decomposition can still recover considerably more reliable metric information from a single RGB image by delegating depth estimation to a model specifically designed for geometric perception.
blocks.zh: 结果还表明,测量的RGB-D信息提供了最准确的几何估计. 这是预期的结果,因为所计量的信息一般比估计数更准确。 尽管如此,通过DA3获得的结果仍然远远比VLM直接得出的深度估计更准确(表一)。 在使用SAM3评估的相同6个VLM后端中,每位配置中位深度误差从直接VLM推算的192.0毫米降至71.3毫米,DA3和面具-中间聚合,相应减少120.7毫米,即62.8%. 同样,平均RMSE从272.0毫米减少到131.5毫米,减少140.6毫米,即51.7%。 在没有RGB-D传感器的情况下,这一点尤其相关,因为它表明,拟议的分解通过将深度估计委托给专门为几何感知设计的模型,仍然可以从单一RGB图像中恢复更可靠的计量信息。

blocks.en: V-E Robot Demonstration
blocks.zh: V-E机器人演示

blocks.en: We carried out a robotic manipulation experiment (Fig. 4 ) to showcase the complete workflow for executing a task from its natural language description and an RGB-D picture of the environment taken with an Orbbec Femto Mega camera.
blocks.zh: 我们进行了一个机器人操纵实验(图4),以展示执行自然语言描述中一项任务的完整工作流程,以及使用Orbbec Femto Mega相机拍摄的RGB-D环境图片。

blocks.en: For the experiment, we considered a UR3 robot equipped with a Robotiq 2F-85 parallel gripper. The robot is asked to sort objects into two colored trays. As a proof of concept, we tested the combination proved to lead to the best results, as shown in Sec. V-C . Hence, we used SAM3 with GPT 5.4, measured depth from the RGB-D camera, and mask-median depth extraction. We integrated the JSON file containing the annotations and the geometric data extracted by the pipeline into the framework of [ 8 ] . This enabled the automatic generation of a behavior tree for the robot’s actions, which was then executed through the ROS2 middleware.
blocks.zh: 对于实验,我们考虑的是装备有Robotiq 2F-85平行抓手的UR3机器人. 机器人被要求将物体排序为两个彩色托盘. 作为概念的证明,我们测试了这种组合,以取得最佳结果,见Sec.V-C.。 因此,我们使用SAM3与GPT 5.4,从RGB-D相机测量深度,以及面具-中间深度提取. 我们把包含说明的JSON文件以及管道提取的几何数据整合到[8]的框架之中. 这使得自动生成用于机器人动作的行为树成为可能,然后通过ROS2中间软件执行.

blocks.en: We conducted three tests with different objects and configurations. The first is depicted in Figure 4 . In a second experiment, we placed an orange block and a yellow block in the red tray and a red block in the space between the two trays. The goal was to place the yellow block in the blue tray, place the red block on top of it and finally place the orange block in between the two trays. Finally, we ran a test in which two blue blocks and two red blocks were scattered in the scenario and had to be positioned inside the corresponding blue and red trays.
blocks.zh: 我们用不同的物体和配置进行了三次测试。 图4显示了第一种情况。 在第二次实验中,我们把一个橙色块和一个黄色块放在红色托盘中,在两个托盘之间的空间中放一个红色块. 目标是将黄色块放在蓝色托盘中,将红色块放在上面,最后将橙色块放在两个托盘之间. 最后,我们进行了一个测试,其中两个蓝色块和两个红色块分散在情景中,不得不在相应的蓝色和红色托盘内定位.

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we presented a modular perception framework for constructing a task-independent object-centric representation of previously unseen robotic workspaces from a single RGB-D observation. The framework explicitly separates semantic interpretation from metric geometric estimation: foundation segmentation models identify candidate scene entities, VLMs provide their semantic annotations, and specialized geometric perception tools associate each entity with metric spatial information.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出了一个模块化的感知框架,用于从单一的RGB-D观测中构建一个以任务为独立的物体为中心,代表先前未见的机器人工作空间. 框架明确将语义解释与计量几何估计区分开来:基础分解模型确定候选场景实体,VLM提供其语义说明,专用几何感知工具将每个实体与计量空间信息联系起来.

blocks.en: The framework addresses a current limitation of existing VLMs. Indeed, we empirically show that direct VLM inference provides strong semantic recognition, but considerably less reliable estimates of object localization and depth. By grounding the semantic predictions through segmentation masks and dedicated depth estimation, the proposed framework preserves comparable semantic performance while substantially reducing geometric error. The depth ablation further shows that aggregating depth over the segmented object region provides a more robust estimate than relying on a single bounding-box-center measurement, while monocular depth estimation offers a viable alternative when RGB-D sensing is unavailable. Finally, integration with the framework from [ 8 ] demonstrates how the resulting representation can directly support downstream task planning and robotic execution.
blocks.zh: 该框架解决了目前对现有自愿终止措施的限制。 确实,我们从经验上证明,直接的VLM推论提供了强烈的语义识别,但对于物体的定位和深度的可靠估计要低得多. 通过分解口罩和专用深度估计将语义预测打下基础,拟议框架保留了可比较的语义性能,同时大幅减少几何误差. 深度偏移进一步表明,集合到分块物体区域的深度比依靠单一的边框-中心测量提供了更可靠的估计,而在无法进行RGB-D感知时,单倍深度估计则提供了一个可行的替代办法。 最后,与来自[8]的框架的整合表明由此产生的代表性如何直接支持下游的任务规划和机器人执行。

blocks.en: Future work will investigate richer geometric representations, including object pose and complete shape estimation, and evaluate how perception errors propagate to task-level performance in more complex and less structured robotic environments.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作将调查更丰富的几何表示,包括物体的姿势和完整的形状估计,并评价在更复杂和结构更简陋的机器人环境中,感知错误如何传播到任务一级的性能。
